name: Ninna UI
summary: Zero-runtime React UI with native Tailwind v4, CSS theming, and Radix accessibility.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of ~69 production components across 12 npm packages.
Docs routes are package-prefixed (/primitives/button) rather than /docs/components/*.
CLI `npx @ninna-ui/cli init` scaffolds apps; catalog copyCode uses per-package pnpm add.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Accessible button with color and size variants.

demo.peerNotes: Install matching @ninna-ui/* package + @ninna-ui/core theme CSS. React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4.

components.copyCode:
pnpm add @ninna-ui/primitives
# Theme CSS (once): @import "@ninna-ui/core/theme/presets/default.css";

import { Button } from "@ninna-ui/primitives"

<Button color="primary">Click me</Button>

copyPrompt.text: Use Ninna UI free MIT React component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://www.ninna-ui.dev/primitives/button. Install with `pnpm add @ninna-ui/primitives` (or npm/yarn), import theme CSS from `@ninna-ui/core/theme/presets/default.css` after Tailwind, then `import { Button } from "@ninna-ui/primitives"`. CLI scaffold: `npx @ninna-ui/cli init my-app`. Docs installation: https://www.ninna-ui.dev/getting-started/installation. Home: https://ninna-ui.dev. Repo: https://github.com/ninna-ui/ninna-ui. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ninna-ui/ninna-ui/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 Ninna-UI Team). Pricing free.
